---
title: "LinDA vs ANCOM-BC2 comparison"
date: "2026-07-14"
output: md_document
---
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

ranks <- c("ASVs", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus")

compare_rank <- function(rank) {
  linda_path <- paste0("../export/linDA_", rank, "_Sig_LFC1.csv")
  ancom_path <- paste0("../export/ancombc2_", rank, "_Sig_LFC1.csv")

  linda <- read_csv(linda_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(key = paste(visit, taxa, sep = "|"))
  ancom <- read_csv(ancom_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(key = paste(visit, taxa, sep = "|"))

  overlap_keys <- intersect(linda$key, ancom$key)

  linda_lfc <- setNames(linda$log2FoldChange, linda$key)
  ancom_lfc <- setNames(ancom$log2FoldChange, ancom$key)

  n_concordant <- sum(sign(linda_lfc[overlap_keys]) == sign(ancom_lfc[overlap_keys]))

  tibble(
    Rank = rank,
    LinDA_sig = nrow(linda),
    ANCOMBC2_sig = nrow(ancom),
    Overlap = length(overlap_keys),
    Concordant_direction = n_concordant,
    ANCOMBC2_only = nrow(ancom) - length(overlap_keys),
    LinDA_only = nrow(linda) - length(overlap_keys)
  )
}

summary_table <- map_dfr(ranks, compare_rank)

knitr::kable(summary_table)
```

```{r}

## Per-taxon detail: abundance, effect size, and significance from both methods ----
detail_rank <- function(rank) {
  linda_path <- paste0("../export/linDA_", rank, "_Sig_LFC1.csv")
  ancom_path <- paste0("../export/ancombc2_", rank, "_Sig_LFC1.csv")

  linda <- read_csv(linda_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(visit, taxa, baseMean, LinDA_LFC = log2FoldChange, LinDA_SE = lfcSE,
           LinDA_padj = padj)

  ancom <- read_csv(ancom_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(visit, taxa, ANCOMBC2_LFC = log2FoldChange, ANCOMBC2_padj = padj,
           ANCOMBC2_passed_ss = passed_ss)

  full_join(linda, ancom, by = c("visit", "taxa")) %>%
    mutate(
      Rank = rank,
      Detected_by = case_when(
        !is.na(LinDA_LFC) & !is.na(ANCOMBC2_LFC) ~ "Both",
        !is.na(LinDA_LFC) & is.na(ANCOMBC2_LFC) ~ "LinDA only",
        is.na(LinDA_LFC) & !is.na(ANCOMBC2_LFC) ~ "ANCOM-BC2 only"
      ),
      Direction_agree = if_else(
        Detected_by == "Both",
        sign(LinDA_LFC) == sign(ANCOMBC2_LFC),
        NA
      )
    ) %>%
    relocate(Rank, .before = visit) %>%
    arrange(desc(Detected_by == "Both"), visit, desc(abs(LinDA_LFC)))
}

detail_table <- map_dfr(ranks, detail_rank)

write_csv(detail_table, '../export/linDA_vs_ancombc2_detail_all_ranks.csv')

knitr::kable(detail_table, digits = 3)
```
